title: Inter 2–0 Stuttgart: Sučić, Lautaro Score — Bastoni a Doubt for Genoa | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Inter can cope without Bastoni — the 2–0 win over Stuttgart is confirmed, his thigh is the worry before Genoa.

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Inter beat VfB Stuttgart 2–0 at San Siro: Sučić 57′ (pen), Lautaro 74′ (Inter.it, Nov 25).
CONFIRMED — Inter rise to 12th in the Champions League with nine points from five matches (Inter.it, Nov 25).
CONFIRMED — Chivu: “We did well in every aspect”; Barella named UEFA Player of the Match (Inter.it, Nov 25).
REPORTED — Bastoni has soreness in his left quadriceps, is due scans, and is a doubt for Genoa (Sky Sport Italia via Calciomercato, Nov 25).
NEXT — Inter vs Genoa, Sat, Nov 28, 2:45 PM ET, 20:45 CET, Serie A matchday 13. US TV: Paramount+.
